data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 invokes 'self-organized criticality' but never explains what concrete evidence would distinguish this from a simpler shared-cause correlation. The problem explicitly asks to identify evidence that separates truly independent failures from merely uncorrelated-appearing ones; SRC_002 argues the network synchronizes on external signals but its counterconditions (heterogeneous monitoring models, absence of external signals) are restatements of the hypothesis, not operational evidence tests that would adjudicate whether observed correlation is self-organized or driven by a single shared cause.
